messages.subject: Re: Problems with plotting
messages.body_plain:
This is probably an issue with the computer machine's memory or RAM- the landcover and elevation data are probably very high resolution. You might need another form of GIS to visualize as Wallace and the leaflet package seem to be unable to load files this big.

On Wednesday, January 19, 2022 at 7:40:24 AM UTC-5 beni...@gmail.com wrote:
> Dear Wallace team,
> I have been able to run my models with corine land cover and srtm elevation data.
> However, in the Visualization/Map Prediction section, Wallace collapses when I click on "plot". The warning message says: "Raster image too large;  33036699  bytes is greater than maximum 4194304 bytes". Do you have any advice as to what I could do to successfully draw the map? If you need any more info, please let me know.
> Best regards,
> Beni
